verdict.rationale: Quo, a business phone SaaS, documents a public, official MCP server on its support site. It lets any agent manage conversations, contacts, messages, call history, voicemail transcripts and missed calls in plain English, and it offers one-click Claude/ChatGPT connectors. missing for 10: documented connection specifics (endpoint URL, auth/transport setup), independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
